name: Kam Deepfury
summary: In Stormwind's Stockade, Kam Deepfury waits apart from the Defias rebels. The Dark Iron dwarf was captured after arranging the blast that shattered the Thandol Span, far to the north.

sections.title: A Saboteur Far from Home
sections.body: Kam Deepfury is a Dark Iron dwarf held deep in the Stormwind Stockade. Most prisoners there are disgruntled Stonemasons or Defias rebels, but he belongs to neither. Captured and brought to Stormwind after an operation crippled vital northern infrastructure, he remains cut off from his kin beneath Blackrock Mountain. Like the rebels who share the corridors, he is hostile to the Alliance.

sections.title: The Thandol Span Sabotage
sections.body: Alliance intelligence at Dun Modr, near the Wetlands' northern border, named Kam Deepfury as the chief architect of the blast that shattered the Thandol Span. The explosion severed one of the massive stone bridges linking the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. It crippled a vital trade and military route for Ironforge and the Alliance, and killed a kin of the dwarf commander Longbraid the Grim.

sections.title: A Score to Settle
sections.body: Motley Garmason and the grieving Longbraid the Grim seek mercenaries in the Wetlands to reach Kam Deepfury in Stormwind's riot-torn Stockade. The Dark Iron insurrectionist has found brief shelter from his victims' relatives in prison. Those seeking him want his head, to settle a bloody grudge begun hundreds of miles to the north.

aliases: who is the dwarf in stockades
faq.answer: Kam Deepfury is a Dark Iron dwarf prisoner held in the Stormwind Stockade. He is known for arranging the sabotage of the Thandol Span and has no allegiance to the Defias rebels imprisoned beside him.

faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf locked in the Stormwind Stockade?
faq.answer: Kam Deepfury was captured after coordinating the blast that shattered one of the Thandol Span's bridges. The explosion killed a dwarf kin of Longbraid the Grim and cut a vital crossing between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Is Kam Deepfury part of the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: No. Kam Deepfury is a Dark Iron dwarf, not a member of the Defias Brotherhood. He is imprisoned alongside the rebels but shares their hostility toward the Alliance.

aliases: who gave the quest for deepfury
faq.answer: Motley Garmason and Longbraid the Grim seek Kam Deepfury's death. The bombing of the Thandol Span killed a kin of Longbraid the Grim, and the two seek mercenaries to reach Deepfury in Stormwind's Stockade.

faq.q: Where did Kam Deepfury commit his crime?
aliases: where was the bridge blown up
faq.answer: Kam Deepfury organized the sabotage at the Thandol Span, where a bridge links the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where can Kam Deepfury be found inside the Stockade?
faq.answer: Kam Deepfury is held deep within the cell blocks of the Stormwind Stockade, beneath Stormwind's canal district.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you know Kam Deepfury as the saboteur who shattered the Thandol Span and killed a kin of Longbraid the Grim. Avenge that loss in the name of honor.
While Stormwind focuses on the Defias uprising, Kam Deepfury reminds the Alliance of the Dark Iron threat to its northern frontiers.
